title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 43. Remains concerned by the Turkish Government’s use of the Turkish diaspora as an instrument for occasional meddling in EU Member States’ domestic policies; calls for the EU institutions and relevant agencies to investigate extensively the official and unofficial activities of Türkiye’s mission to the EU, specifically the ways in which it influences decision-making processes;
